name: 06-21-llm-run-execution-deadlock-off-turn
title: Run off-actor LLM execution truly off grain turn (fix self-deadlock)
description: Deployed feature/integrate@45c1bd20: LlmRunExecutionGAgent.HandleExecuteAsync awaits the entire LLM run in one grain turn while the record sink delivers back to the same grain -> self-deadlock -> chat/completions & responses get no terminal -> SSE truncates, client gets no reply. Fix: execute the run truly off any grain turn and stop the record sink from requiring delivery back to the occupied grain.
creator: eanzhao
